prompt:
Use case: compositing / illustration-story.
Asset type: one production-ready panoramic transparent PNG background illustration for cosmicbullshit.com.
Input images: the supplied left-sky.png and right-sky.png are the exact style and subject references. Preserve their antique plum engraved linework, cream painted cloud interiors, sleepy crescent moon with face and tiny orbiting airplane on the left, ringed Saturn on the right, and sparse hand-engraved stars.
Primary request: replace the two disconnected panels with ONE continuous panoramic celestial illustration. Join their billowing clouds across the entire middle into a single coherent cloud bank with no panel seams, no vertical cutoffs, and no rectangular lower boundary. Width-to-height ratio 2:1, high resolution ideally 3072 by 1536.
Composition: moon and airplane grouped in the left outer quarter; Saturn in the right outer quarter. Keep the central 35 percent mostly clear above the lower clouds because the existing fortune-teller cabinet will overlay this area. Cloud bank rises at both outer sides and flows continuously through the lower middle. The bottom contour must have irregular rounded scallops and tapered little cloud wisps, all completely contained within the canvas with a transparent margin below: it must never end in a straight horizontal crop. Only the far left and right sides may extend to the image edges. Do not draw the cabinet, character, paper fortune, typography, controls, frames, or interface.
Style: match the actual references closely: thin dark plum #40192e ink, charming Victorian copperplate hatching and stippling, softly cream #f3d9ad filled clouds and moon. No photographic or 3D clouds, no gradients or glow, no new motifs. Keep the sky genuinely alpha-transparent between the stars, between the subject groups and above/below the natural cloud silhouette. Preserve opaque cream paint within the illustrated objects. Do not draw paper texture, solid background, checkerboard, or black background. This will sit on the existing textured ochre webpage.
